_source: WYSIWYR clinician evaluation protocol (revised manuscript). Fixed before evaluation; recorded here so the design is auditable independently of the rating data.
_note: This file records the DESIGN ONLY. The analysis code that consumes the rating table lives in analysis/clinician_mixed_effects.R and analysis/clinician_agreement.py.
_data_location: The original completed clinician-rating records were not located in the current reproducibility archive (searched on the analysis server and in the local project archives on 2026-09-17). See README 'Not released / data-only restrictions'.

manuscript_reported_condition_means._note: reported in the manuscript; recomputable only once the completed rating records are available

statistical_analysis.implementation: R ordinal::clmm (see analysis/clinician_mixed_effects.R); Python has no equivalent crossed-random-effects ordinal model

data_access.evidence: the analysis server and the local project archives were searched on 2026-09-17; no completed clinician rating table was located. The blinded rating sheets that do exist are empty templates (all rating columns blank).
data_access.consequence: The manuscript's clinician OR / CI / p / ICC / kappa values cannot be independently recomputed from the current public archive.
data_access.policy: Any future sharing of human-evaluation data must comply with the applicable ethical and privacy requirements.

required_columns.condition: report condition, 3 levels (identity concealed during rating)
